description: Head-by-head activation patching: the interchange of patching.json, but of ONE attention head's result at a time, swept over the four heads of layer 0. The site is `attention_premix`, the output projection's input, served per head as (num_heads, head_dim) — every head's result side by side — so a site selects on its `num_heads` axis, and this runs on the hooks engine too, which reaches it at the projection's input; `attention_head_outputs` is the same tensor read inside the attention's forward, which nnterp serves under eager attention only; with `attn_implementation: eager` it gives the same numbers bit for bit.
